welcome.tagline: One Pico W / Pico 2 W to automate your Switch and bring your Pro Controller 2 to PC and Mac.
welcome.note1: This is an unofficial tool with no affiliation to Nintendo.
welcome.note2: Automation in online play risks having your account suspended. Keep it to offline, solo play.

macroManual.title: Standalone Macro Guide
macroManual.introC: The C button becomes the record/replay control and is never sent to the game.
macroManual.introSlots: 8 save slots, each holding up to 90 seconds of recording.
macroManual.rec1: One buzz means armed. C and GL/GR may be pressed in either order.
macroManual.rec2: 0.5 s after everything is released, one buzz marks the start. The release itself is not recorded.
macroManual.rec3: Your input keeps reaching the game while it is being recorded. Recording stops automatically after 90 seconds.
macroManual.rec4: Ends the recording. The game input goes neutral, and this C press is neither recorded nor forwarded.
macroManual.rec5: A slot button (A/B/X/Y/L/R/ZL/ZR) saves, C discards. Nothing here reaches the game. Normal play resumes after saving.
macroManual.play1: Hold C first, then press a slot button to loop-play it. Live input is not forwarded during playback.
macroManual.play2: C stops playback. Normal play resumes after stopping.
macroManual.vib1Desc: State change (armed / recording started / recording stopped / playback stopped)
macroManual.vib2Desc: Success (saved to a slot / playback started)
macroManual.vib3Desc: Discarded (C pressed to discard / nothing was recorded)
macroManual.vib4Desc: Error (the slot is empty / saving failed)
macroManual.note1: Only buttons and sticks are recorded. The gyro is not, and gyro output is paused while recording.
macroManual.note2: Game rumble is muted while recording or playing back, so it cannot be confused with the recorder's cues.
macroManual.note3: GL / GR trigger recording and therefore have no slots (they still work as normal buttons).
